label: early original-phase input of m/x/s/i/1/t/p
explanation: Fires almost only during the original (input) phase (98% of mass), mostly at positions 1-5. It is barely active at t=0 or late positions (t>=7), and almost never at the delimiter or during copy. It is input-token selective: m is strongest (30% active rate), then x, s, i, 1, t, p, with weaker firing on a and 0. Activation is higher on a token first occurrence (in_first). It is also higher when the sequence starts with z/e/b/3 and after prev tokens 1/q/x/0, so the hidden-state context modulates it. Top activations (about 0.37) are m/x/s/i/1 at positions 3-5 after prefixes like e z ... or b z .... The predicate gets about 80% of the activation mass, but precision is only about 0.38 because many of these token occurrences stay below threshold depending on context. About 18% of the mass is on other tokens (e.g. a, 0, y, f, o) in similar early positions.
